entry.name: makenote
entry.description: Outputs a MIDI note-on message paired with a velocity value followed by a note-off message after a specified amount of time. This allows for generative MIDI output without having to manage note-off generation.

arguments.name: velocity
arguments.description: Sets an initial velocity value (int or float) to be paired with incoming pitch numbers. If there is no argument, the initial velocity is.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: Sets an initial note duration (time before a note-off is sent out), in any of Max's time units. A simple int or float will set the duration in milliseconds. If the second argument is not present, the note-off follows the note-on immediately.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: Sets an initial MIDI channel number. If a third argument is used, theobject will have an additional fourth inlet (which specifies MIDI channel number) and an additional third outlet (which specifies MIDI output channel).

attributes.name: repeatmode
attributes.digest: Retrigger behavior
attributes.description: Sets behavior when a note is retriggered. The modes are:repeatmode 0 (default): There is no pre-specified behavior when when you repeat a pitch before the note-off for that pitch has been sent.repeatmode 1: If a note is still playing when you retrigger it, theobject will send a note-off (velocity 0) message to stop the first note and then send a new note-on message.repeatmode 2: If a note is still playing when you retrigger it, theobject will cancel the scheduled output of the first note - only the last played note will send note-off (velocity 0) message.repeatmode 3: If a note is still playing when you retrigger it, theobject will reschedule the note-off output of the first note without triggering a new note-on message.repeatmode 4: If a note is still playing when you retrigger it, theobject will ignore the retriggered note and leave the note-off time unaffected.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Erases all notes currently held by, without sending note-offs.

messages.name: clock
messages.description: The word, followed by the name of an existingobject, sets theobject to be controlled by thatobject rather than by Max’s internal millisecond clock. The wordby itself sets theobject back to using Max’s regular millisecond clock.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In first inlet: The number is treated as a pitch value for a MIDI note-on message. It is paired with a velocity value and the numbers are sent out the outlets. After a certain time, a note-off message (a note-on with a velocity of 0) is sent out for that pitch.In second inlet: The number is stored as a velocity to be paired with pitch numbers received in the left inlet.In third inlet: The number is stored as the duration thatwaits before a note-off message is sent out.In fourth inlet: The number specifies a MIDI output channel. The fourth inlet will only be present if theobject is initialized with three arguments.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In first inlet: The number is treated as a pitch value for a MIDI note-on message. It is paired with a velocity value and the numbers are sent out the outlets. After a certain time, a note-off message (a note-on with a velocity of 0) is sent out for that pitch.In second inlet: The number is stored as a velocity to be paired with pitch numbers received in the left inlet.In third inlet: The number is stored as the duration thatwaits before a note-off message is sent out.In fourth inlet: The number specifies a MIDI output channel. The fourth inlet will only be present if theobject is initialized with three arguments.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: The second number is treated as the velocity and is sent out the right outlet. The first number is treated as the pitch and is sent out the left outlet. A corresponding note-off message is sent out later.If theobject is instantiated with three arguments, a four-item list can be used which contains an additional fourth element specifying the MIDI channel number, which is sent out the rightmost outlet of the object.

messages.name: stop
messages.description: Causesto send out immediate note-offs for all pitches it currently holds.
